description: Parking de covoiturage multimodal is a dataset listed in Data64 open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département des Pyrénées Atlantiques. Jeu de données reprenant la Base Nationale Consolidée des lieux de Covoiturage (BNLC, Point d'Accès National transport.data.gouv.fr, 2023, sous licence ODbL) sur le Département des Pyrénées-Atlantiques enrichie par des informations sur la multimodalité. Coverage: Pyrénées-Atlantiques. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are mobilite douce, vivre dans le 64. The portal shows 98 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-08-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-le64-fr-portal.
